title: The Story of Mankind
summary: "The Story of Mankind" by Hendrik Willem Van Loon is a book published in 1921. Written for his children, this illustrated history traces Western civilization from primitive humans through the development of writing, art, architecture, and religion to the modern nation-state. Van Loon includes only those people and events that fundamentally altered civilization's course. The book won the inaugural Newbery Medal in 1922 for outstanding children's literature.
